questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 12 × 8 ÷ 36 + 3 - 6 = 102
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

12 × 8 ÷ 36 + 3 - 6 = 102
questions.solution:
Interchanging × and +

12 + 8 ÷ 36 + 3 – 6 = 12 + 22 + 3 - 6

9.22 ≠ 102

Interchanging + and -

12 × 8 ÷ 36 - 3 + 6

= 12 × .22 - 3 + 6

= 5.22 ≠ 102

Interchanging - and ÷

12 × 8 - 36 + 3 ÷ 6

= 96 - 36 + .5

= 60 + .5

= 60.5 ≠ 102

Interchanging ÷ and +

12 × 8 + 36 ÷ 3 - 6

= 12 × 8 + 12 - 6

= 96 + 12 - 6

= 108 - 6

= 102 = 102

Hence, by interchanging ÷ and + we get the correct equation.

questions.question: Vishal is three times as old as Saksham. After 8 years, he will be two times as old as Saksham. After further 8 years, what will be Vishal’s age?
questions.questionHtml: Vishal is three times as old as Saksham. After 8 years, he will be two times as old as Saksham. After further 8 years, what will be Vishal’s age?
questions.solution:
Let present age of Saksham be x, therefore age of Vishal will be 3x.

Age of Saksham after 8 years = x + 8,

According to the question age of Vishal after 8 years

= 2(x + 8).

And also, age of Vishal after 8 years = 3x + 8.

Comparing Vishal age after 8 years we get,

3x + 8 = 2(x + 8)

3x + 8 = 2x + 16

3x - 2x = 16 - 8

X = 8

Present age of Saksham = 8 years and age of Vishal = 3 × 8 = 24

Hence, Age of Saksham and Vishal after 8 year = 8 + 8 = 16 and 24 + 8 = 32

Age of Saksham and Vishal after 8 more years = 16 + 8 = 24 and 32 + 8 = 40

Hence, '40 years’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure the intensity of light produced by an unknown source in terms of a standard source?
questions.questionHtml: Which instrument is used to measure the intensity of light produced by an unknown source in terms of a standard source?
questions.solution:
Photometer is used to measure the intensity of light produced by an unknown source in terms of a standard source.

  • It is an instrument that measures the strength of electromagnetic radiation in the range from ultraviolet to infrared and including the visible spectrum.
  • Most photometers convert light into an electric current using a photoresistor, photodiode, or photomultiplier.
  • Photometers are used to determine the correct exposure in photography.
  • Photometers measure Illuminance, Irradiance, Light absorption, Scattering of light, Reflection of light, Fluorescence, Phosphorescence and Luminescence.

questions.question: Which of the following is the 6th highest waterfall in India?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is the 6th highest waterfall in India?
questions.solution:
Correct Answer Thalaiyar Falls

Key Points:

The Thalaiyar Falls is the 6th highest waterfall in India.

  • Thalaiyar Falls also known as Rat Tail Falls is located in the Devadanapatti Dindigul District, Tamil Nadu.
  • It is 975 ft (297 m) tall and is the highest waterfall in Tamil Nadu.
  • It is the 267th highest waterfall in the world.

Additional Information:

Courtallam Falls:-

  • Courtallam is situated at the Western Ghats in Tenkasi District. 
  • The famous waterfalls on rocks and tiny droplets are sprinkled in the air. 
  • The water falls of Courtallam have medicinal value as they run through forest and herbs before their decent.
  • The Courtallam is called as ‘Spa’ of South India.

Agaya Gangai:-

  • Agaya Gangai waterfalls are located in Kolli Hills of the Eastern Ghats, in India.

Suruli Falls:

  • Suruli falls is one of the famous falls in Tamilnadu, known for its peerless beauty.
  • This falls is situated near Theni district and is visited by many tourists every year. 
  • This falls is a two-step falls, first section falling from the height of 150 feet.
  • It flows down as a small pool, later cascading at the height of 40 feet.

questions.question: According to _____, pressure is equal to the force divided by the area on which it acts.

questions.solution:
According to Pascal's Law, the pressure is equal to the force divided by the area on which it acts. Pascal's Law:- Pascal's Law is a principle in fluid mechanics given by Blaise Pascal that states that a pressure change at any point in a confined incompressible fluid is transmitted throughout the fluid such that the same change occurs everywhere.  Blaise Pascal was a French Mathematician.

  • Newton's Law:- Newton's Law based on the law of motion.
  • Stefan-Boltzmann Law:- The Stefan–Boltzmann law describes the power radiated from a black body in terms of its temperature.
  • Hooke's Law:-  Hooke's law is a law of physics that states that the force (F) needed to extend or compress a spring by some distance x scales linearly with respect to that distance.

questions.question: Find the value of 7.2 + (8.4 ÷ 0.12 × 0.2) - 5 × 3 ÷ 0.05 + 3
questions.questionHtml: Find the value of 7.2 + (8.4 ÷ 0.12 × 0.2) - 5 × 3 ÷ 0.05 + 3
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below:

Step-1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4: Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.      

⇒ 7.2 + (8.4 ÷ 0.12 × 0.2) - 5 × 3 ÷ 0.05 + 3

⇒ 7.2 + (70 × 0.2) - 5 × 60 + 3

⇒ 7.2 + 14 - 300 + 3

⇒ 24.2 - 300

⇒ -275.8

questions.question: In a circle with center O, AB is the diameter and CD is a chord such that ABCD is a trapezium. If ∠BAC = 18°, then ∠CAD is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: In a circle with center O, AB is the diameter and CD is a chord such that ABCD is a trapezium. If ∠BAC = 18°, then ∠CAD is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given, ∠BAC = 18°

⇒ ∠ACB = 90° [Angle in a semicircle is 90°]

In ΔACB

⇒ ∠ACB + ∠CBA + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠CBA = 180° - 90° - 18° = 72°

⇒ ∠DCA = ∠CAB = 18° [Alternate interior angle]

⇒ ∠DCA = ∠ABD = 18°            and ∠CAD = ∠DBC

∵ Two inscribed angles forming the same arc or forming two equal arcs are equal

⇒ ∠CBA = ∠DBC + ∠ABD

⇒ 72° = ∠DBC + 18°

⇒ ∠DBC = 72° - 18° = 54°

⇒ ∠CAD = ∠DBC = 54°

questions.question: In ΔABC, AD is a median and P is a point on AD such that AP : PD = 3 : 4. Then ar(ΔBPD) : ar(ΔABC) is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: In ΔABC, AD is a median and P is a point on AD such that AP : PD = 3 : 4. Then ar(ΔBPD) : ar(ΔABC) is equal to:
questions.solution:
Concept Used:

AD is median, so AD divides the triangle into two equal part

ar ΔADB = ar ΔADC

In a triangle, the area ratio between two sub-triangles with the same height (which, in this case, is represented by the length of the line perpendicular from the base to the opposite vertex) is the same as the ratio of their bases.

Calculation:

AD is median, so AD divides the triangle into two equal part

ar ΔADB = ar ΔADC

In ΔABD

⇒ ar ΔBPD/ar ΔAPB = DP/AP

⇒ ar ΔBPD/ar ΔAPB = 4/3

Let the area of ΔBPD be 4 unit

So, the area of ΔAPB will be = 3 unit

So, area of ΔBAD = ar ΔBPD + ar ΔAPB = 4 + 3 = 7 unit

Area of ΔABC = 2 × ar ΔBAD = 2 × 7 = 14 unit

∴ ar ΔBPD : ar ΔABC = 4 : 14 = 2 : 7

questions.question: If a + b + c = 6 and ab + bc + ca = 4, then a 3 + b 3 + c 3 - 3abc is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If a + b + c = 6 and ab + bc + ca = 4, then a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> - 3abc is equal to:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Direct formula for a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc using sum and pairwise product sum:

Value = (a + b + c) × [(a + b + c)2 − 3(ab + bc + ca)]

Substitute values: 6 × [62 − 3 × 4]

⇒ 6 × [36 − 12] = 6 × 24 = 144

∴ The correct answer is 144.

Alternate Method

Given: a + b + c = 6 and ab + bc + ca = 4

Method: Algebraic Identity expansion

Step 1: Find the value of a2 + b2 + c2 using the square of a trinomial.

⇒ (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 62 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(4)

⇒ 36 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 8

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 = 36 − 8 = 28

Step 2: Use the standard identity for a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc.

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 − (ab + bc + ca))

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 6 × (28 − 4)

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 6 × 24 = 144

∴ The correct answer is 144.

Additional Information

Zero Sum Condition

If a + b + c = 0, then a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc. This is a very common variation in exams.

Alternative Form of Identity

a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 0.5 × (a + b + c)[(a − b)2 + (b − c)2 + (c − a)2], used when differences are given.

Sum of Squares Identity

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca) is the fundamental relation used to link these variables.

questions.question: A is 40% more efficient than B and C is 20% less efficient than B. Working together, they can complete a task in 20 hours. In how many hours will A alone complete 35% of that task?

The tense of the verb of the sentence is past indefinite tense. Therefore was should be as the be verb followed by the word ever and the past participle of the word trust i.e. trusted.

After this the preposition by and the object i.e her should be written.

So option 1 is the answer.

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. A. But the rest of the students were rushing past her for a break, like she didn't exist. B. She slowly pushed open the library door and took a seat at one of the tables in the corner. C. And today, Jessica really felt like maybe she didn't exist. D. When the bell rang for lunch, Jessica took her lunch box and started moving towards the library
questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

A. But the rest of the students were rushing past her for a break, like she didn't exist.

B. She slowly pushed open the library door and took a seat at one of the tables in the corner.

C. And today, Jessica really felt like maybe she didn't exist.

D. When the bell rang for lunch, Jessica took her lunch box and started moving towards the library
questions.solution:
The correct answer is DACB

Key Points

  • The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
  • The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, the starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
  • Part D will be the first sentence because it is talking about a past happening. It is talking about how the incident began.
  • Part A will be the second sentence because it has 'but'. You use but to introduce something which contrasts with what you have just said, or to introduce something which adds to what you have just said. This statement mentions contrary part of what has been mentioned in D
  • Part C will be the next in sequence. It explains how Jessica felt on being ignored.
  • Part B will be the next sentence because it mentions what Jessica finally did on being left alone.

Thus, the sentences will be arranged as: When the bell rang for lunch, Jessica took her lunch box and started moving towards the library. But the rest of the students were rushing past her for a break, like she didn't exist. And today, Jessica really felt like maybe she didn't exist. She slowly pushed open the library door and took a seat at one of the tables in the corner.

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order. A. questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. Then, they spread as the unmined coal starts burning with oxygen drawn from pores and mine shafts.

B. An entire township- Jharia is to be relocated because of the uncontrollable underground fires.

C. These fires start mostly from burning trash close to coal pits.

D. This is a grave threat as poisonous fumes of carbon monoxide rise up from underground fires.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1 , i.e. BCAD

The first sentence is B , --An entire township- Jharia is to be relocated because of the uncontrollable underground fires. because a topic is introduced here.

The next sentence should be   C --These fires start mostly from burning trash close to coal pits. because it is giving some information about the fire that is mentioned in the first sentence.

The third sentence is A --Then, they spread as the unmined coal starts burning with oxygen drawn from pores and mine shafts. because it is stating what happens after the fire starts burning.

The fourth sentence is D --This is a grave threat as poisonous fumes of carbon monoxide rise up from underground fires. because it is about the result of burning.

That is why option 1 is the correct answer.
